hub.title: Pose Reference & Style Guide: Photo Poses, Anime Hairstyles and Outfits
hub.description: 62 references for drawing, cosplay and photography: poses, camera angles, anime hairstyles, hair colours, expressions, hand gestures and outfits, most with photos.
hub.lede: What a look is called, how it varies, how to draw it and how to pose for it: hairstyles, hair colours, expressions, hand gestures, outfits, traditional clothing, poses and camera angles, most with reference photos.
about: Each entry answers what the look is first, then lists its variations, gives construction tips for illustrators and posing or styling tips for cosplayers and photographers.

Reference photos come from the cosplay and portrait archive at mfan8.com and are shown from there with credit; select one to see the full photo set. Prompt keywords at the end of each entry help when you search for more references or describe the look to an image tool.

faq.q: Can I use these photos as drawing reference?
faq.a: Yes, for study and practice. The photos belong to their photographers and models, so do not trace or republish them; follow the link to see the original set and its credits.

faq.q: Where do the photos come from?
faq.a: From mfan8.com, a cosplay and portrait photography archive. They are displayed from that site, not copied to cv.cm, and each one links back to its source page.

faq.q: What are the prompt keywords for?
faq.a: They are the common English tags for each look, useful in image search, on reference boards and in AI image tools.
